facts: The body says custom property values store data on specific work items, then contains only The values object, Attributes and one 200 response example.
Attributes describe workspace/project ownership, audit fields and external correlation; there is no method, endpoint path, request body, action instruction or operation link.
The example has option-style name, sort_order, is_default, property and parent fields, but no submitted value field. It does not establish the add/get/update/delete value operations' request shapes.

conflicts.section: Overview and THE VALUES OBJECT response example
conflicts.excerpt: Custom property values store the data entered into custom properties on specific work items.
conflicts.resolution: The value resource description and option-shaped example do not establish a usable value-write schema; retain operation-specific value contracts rather than infer one from the example.
